items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Grundsteuerwert-Fortschreibungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Aufgabe zur Post was Saturday, 21.11.2026. Per § 122 Abs. 2a AO (as amended, 4-day fiction) the notice is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting 22.11 (Sun, day1), 23.11 (Mon, day2), 24.11 (Tue, day3), 25.11 (Wed, day4) -> fictive Bekanntgabe = 25.11.2026 (Wednesday, not a weekend/holiday, so no shift). The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 AO) runs from Bekanntgabe per §§108 AO, 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (25.11) is excluded for the start of counting but the end of a month-period falls on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is a Friday and a public holiday (1. Weihnachtstag) in NRW, so per §108 Abs.3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day. 26.12.2026 (Saturday) is also a public holiday (2. Weihnachtstag) in NRW, 27.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves further to the next working day, Monday 28.12.2026.
